Class ChangesRest

jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.RestServlet

org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.PetstoreConsolePage
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pets.ChangesRest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable, BasicUniversalConfig, DefaultConfig, DefaultHtmlConfig
public class ChangesRest extends PetstoreConsolePage
Pending changes: the staged-edits table. Persistent selection is limited to PENDING rows, an aggregate Discard returns a BulkResult, a perRow Apply writes each change to its pet, and a perRow Retry re-applies a failed change. Also the data source of the header pending-changes badge.
Example:

selection: { rowIdField:'id', selectAll:true, scope:'persistent', labelField:'summary', selectableWhen:[{field:'state', op:'eq', value:'PENDING', reason:'Only pending changes can be discarded or applied.'}] }, bulk: { actions: [ { id:'discard', label:'Discard', bulkMode:'aggregate', endpoint:'/console/pets/changes/discard', method:'POST', tone:'danger' }, { id:'apply', label:'Apply', bulkMode:'perRow', endpoint:'/console/pets/changes/{id}/apply', method:'POST' } ] }

@RestPost(path="/discard") public BulkResult discard(RestRequest req, @Content BulkRequest body) { var o = store().pendingChanges().discard(body.ids, ConsoleWrites.actor(req)); var b = BulkResult.create().succeeded(o.succeeded().toArray(String[]::new)).notFound(...); o.failed().forEach(f -> b.failed(new BulkResult.Failure(f.id(), f.message()))); return b.build(); }
